meaning: "Wondrous Lord" (literally, "Wow, the Guru"): the name of God most used in Sikh simran, remembrance.
purpose: To fill the mind with wonder and remembrance.
when: On the breath, with a mala, or in song.
note: Simran, the repeated remembrance of the divine name, is central to Sikh devotion.
name: Waheguru
